title: Little Sister's Big Request

{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW Little Sister's Big Request.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Jana]] |location= South Akkala Stable |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Silver Rupee}} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|Little Sister's Big Request||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|Little Sister's Big Request}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|South Akkala Stable}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== This [[Side Quest]] can be obtained from [[Jana]], a worker at the [[South Akkala Stable]]. Initially, Jana is dismissive towards [[Link]] and will ask him what he wants.{{Cite|What do YOU want?|Jana|BotW}} If Link says he is just hanging out, Jana will be suspicious of him but asks that he leaves her alone, as she is thinking about something.{{Cite|[I'm just hanging out...] We'll see about that... I'm thinking about something right now... Can you please not bother me?|Jana|BotW}} During this time, if Link speaks to Jana's little sister, [[Gleema]], she will share that Jana loves [[Armoranth]]s.{{Cite|My big sister, Jana, loves {{Color BotW|Blue|armoranth}}!|Gleema|BotW}} When Link speaks to Jana with at least one [[Armoranth]] in his [[Inventory]], she will take notice and ask for it.{{Cite|Hmmm... What's that? What do you have there? That's {{Color BotW|Blue|armoranth}}, isn't it?! Could you...um...maybe give me some?|Jana|BotW}} If Link allows her to take it, Jana states that, since he had her favorite plant, she may be able to get along with him.{{Cite|For you to be walking around with my favorite plant... It seems you and I may just get along after all.|Jana|BotW}} She asks what Link is doing in [[Akkala]],{{Cite|{{Color BotW|Blue|Akkala}} is famous for... Well, nothing. So I have to ask... What could you possibly have come here for?|Jana|BotW}} and if he responds that he is a traveler or an adventurer, she will have a request.{{Cite|I see... A traveler, eh? In that case, I have a request for you.|Jana|BotW}} Jana shares that Gleema is a fan of [[Insect]]s, which she does not understand.{{Cite|My little sister, Gleema, is a huge fan of {{Color BotW|Blue|insects}}. I know, I don't get it either.|Jana|BotW}} She knows that there is a Insect that Gleema wants to see, but she will not tell her what it is.{{Cite|But apparently there's a certain {{Color BotW|Blue|insect}} she's dying to see in real life. She won't tell me about it, though. I suppose there are some things you just can't talk about with those you're closest to.|Jana|BotW}} She asks Link to talk with Gleema and see if he can figure out what she wants to see,{{Cite|Anyway, would you mind talking to her and trying to figure out which silly {{Color BotW|Blue|insect}} she's so crazy about?|Jana|BotW}} as it is for Gleema's birthday.{{Cite|It's for her birthday... Think of it as a special birthday favor. Ooh, or even a birthday quest. Look, just do it, OK?|Jana|BotW}} This begins the Side Quest. Gleema will tell Link that she has a secret when he speaks to her, and she asks if he wants to know it.{{Cite|Hey, guess what! I have? A SECRET! Wanna know what it is?!|Gleema|BotW}} She reveals that Jana hates [[Dragonfly|Dragonflies]].{{Cite|♪Tee heeeee!♪ OK, I'm gonna tell you! Ready? Here it coooooomes! My big sister, Jana, hates {{Color BotW|Blue|dragonflies}}!|Gleema|BotW}} Once, she saw a picture of a [[Warm Darner]], a [[Cold Darner]], and an [[Electric Darner]] in a book,{{Cite|I once saw pictures of a {{Color BotW|Blue|warm darner}}, a {{Color BotW|Blue|cold darner}}, and an {{Color BotW|Blue|electric darner}} in a book...|Gleema|BotW}} but Jana thought their eyes were creepy and was upset.{{Cite|But when I showed them to Jana, she said their eyes were creepy and got mad.|Gleema|BotW}} Gleema is shocked when he remembers that was a secret and believes that Jana will be mad.{{Cite|... Oh... That was a secret, wasn't it?! Jana is gonna be mad at me again!|Gleema|BotW}} However, Gleema believes the only reason Jana did not like them was because of the up-close pictures, and she thinks real Dragonflies would be cute.{{Cite|But I think that's because the pictures were all up close and stuff! I bet real ones are super cute!|Gleema|BotW}} When she grows up, Gleema wants to travel the world and meet Dragonflies.{{Cite|When I grow up, I wanna travel the world and meet some real {{Color BotW|Blue|dragonflies}}!|Gleema|BotW}} Returning to Jana, she is shocked to hear that Gleema wants to see a Warm Darner, a Cold Darner, and an Electric Darner.{{Cite|No... now way! Of all things, she wants to see a gross {{Color BotW|Blue|dragonfly}}?! A {{Color BotW|Blue|warm darner}}, a {{Color BotW|Blue|cold darner}}, AND an {{Color BotW|Blue|electric darner}}? {{Color BotW|Red|Three different types}}?!|Jana|BotW}} She realizes that Gleema did not tell her because of how much she dislikes them.{{Cite|Ugggh... Anything but {{Color BotW|Blue|dragonflies}}... Just thinking about their eyes makes me feel sick. I see. So Gleema knows that I despise {{Color BotW|Blue|dragonflies}}, and that's why she wouldn't tell me how much she loves them...|Jana|BotW}} Since it is for her birthday, Jana asks Link to bring her the three different Dragonflies for Gleema's surprise.{{Cite|Well, this is her birthday wish... I didn't have a choice. Bring me a {{Color BotW|Blue|warm darner}}, {{Color BotW|Blue|cold darner}}, and {{Color BotW|Blue|electric darner}}, please. I want to surprise Gleema, so don't tell her about this!|Jana|BotW}}{{Note|If Link already has all three dragonflies, he will not have to go looking for them.{{Cite|Hey... You already found them all, didn't you?|Jana|BotW}}}} Warm Darners are common in [[Hyrule Field]] and the [[Akkala Highlands]]. Cold Darners can be found on [[Hyrule Ridge]] and in cold areas, such as the [[Tabantha Frontier]]. Finally, Electric Darners are also found on Hyrule Ridge, specifically around [[Rutile Lake]], but they can also be located within the [[Gerudo Canyon]]. In addition, [[Beedle]] sells certain Dragonflies depending on his location. When Link returns to South Akkala Stable with the Dragonflies, Jana will ask for them.{{Cite|Have you secured a {{Color BotW|Blue|warm darner}}, {{Color BotW|Blue|cold darner}}, and {{Color BotW|Blue|electric darner}}? {{Small|{{Color BotW|Gray|*gulp*}}}} Right... In that case, may I have them?|Jana|BotW}} However, she is unable to bring herself to take them from Link, and she tells Link to give them to Gleema for her.{{Cite|... ... {{Small|Ewww...}} BAH! I CAN'T DO THIS! Please give them to her...just...give them to Gleema yourself!|Jana|BotW}} At first, Gleema is intrigued to hear that Link has something for her.{{Cite|[These are for you.] Really? What is it? What is it?!|Gleema|BotW}} She is shocked to see the Dragonflies and asks if they are really for her.{{Cite|{{Big|WOW! Real-life {{Color BotW|Blue|dragonflies}}!!}} Are these really for me?!|Gleema|BotW}} Excitedly, she calls out to Jana and runs to show her the Dragonflies.{{Cite|Hey, Big Sis! Lookee, lookee! It's a real life {{Color BotW|Blue|warm darner}}! And a {{Color BotW|Blue|cold darner}} and an {{Color BotW|Blue|electric darner}} too!! I'll bring 'em over so you can see!|Gleema|BotW}} Jana yells at her to stop,{{Cite|{{Big|HEY! Cut it out!!}}|Jana|BotW}} before eventually screeching in terror.{{Cite|{{Big|EEEEEEK!!}}|Jana|BotW}} After Jana has calmed down,{{Cite|Hey. I've managed to calm down. Somehow.|Jana|BotW}} she decides to thank Link for catching the Dragonflies.{{Cite|Now then... I must thank you for catching those {{Color BotW|Blue|dragonflies}}.|Jana|BotW}} She gives him a [[Silver Rupee]].{{Cite|Here, take this.|Jana|BotW}} She explains to Link that while she is okay with other Insects, she can not stand Dragonflies.{{Cite|I'm find with most insects. The only ones I simply can't stand are {{Color BotW|Blue|dragonflies}}. When I think about them looking at me with those evil eyes... *shudder*|Jana|BotW}} With a sigh, she tells herself to take a deep breath.{{Cite|*sigh* That was rough. OK... I need to take a deep breath.|Jana|BotW}} Once she is done speaking, the Side Quest ends. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Jana wants to give her insect-loving little sister, Gleema, a birthday gift. But no matter what how many times Jana asks, Gleema won't tell her what kind of bug she wants.

You should talk to {{Color BotW|Red|Gleema}} for the full story. |- | 2 | Gleema told you that she loves dragonflies above all other insects, but Jana can't stand the sight of them. You now understand why Gleema can't tell her sister what she wants.

You'll have to tell {{Color BotW|Red|Jana}} so the two of you can decide what to do. |- | 3 | Despite Jana's severe aversion to dragonflies, she's determined to give her little sister the birthday gift she wants.

Bring {{Color BotW|Red|Jana}} one {{Color BotW|Red|warm darner}}, one {{Color BotW|Red|cold darner}}, and one {{Color BotW|Red|electric darner}}. |- | 4 | Unsurprisingly, Jana couldn't bring herself to take the dragonflies from you.

Give {{Color BotW|Red|Gleema}} the {{Color BotW|Red|warm darner}}, {{Color BotW|Red|cold darner}}, and {{Color BotW|Red|electric darner}} yourself. |- | 5 | You gave Gleema the warm darner, cold darner, and electric darner.

In her excitement, she forgot herself and rushed to show Jana. Can {{Color BotW|Red|Jana}}'s nerves take the strain? |- | Complete | You gave Gleema the warm darn, cold darner, and electric darner.

Jana gave you a reward for all your trouble. }} ==Trivia== * This Side Quest is referenced by the "[[Anything but Bugs]]" [[Quest]] from {{AoC}}, in which the owner of [[South Akkala Stable]] wants to gather [[Insect]]s for his daughter's birthday, despite his fear of them.{{Cite|A stable master is searching for a birthday gift for his child: cool-looking insects. He can't find them on his own though, because he hates bugs! Find the insects for him.|Gallery (Interface)|AoC}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Gleema * Jana * South Akkala Stable }} {{Notes}} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
